name: Happy Ads
author: happypay

sections.description:
Happy Ads integrates your store with the Happy Ads platform to track product views and cart interactions, providing valuable marketing insights.

Key Features

  • Lightweight Integration – Easy setup with minimal configuration
  • Product View Tracking – Track when customers view your products
  • Cart Action Monitoring – Monitor add to cart and remove from cart actions
  • Performance Optimized – Minimal impact on your store’s performance
  • Secure Data Handling – Safe and secure data transmission
  • Error Tracking – Built-in error tracking and reporting

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or later
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or later
  • PHP 7.2 or later

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services provided by a sub contractor of Happy Pay (Pty) Ltd – Valyrion ApS:

  1. Valyrion ApS Integration API (https://integration.valyrion.com/woocommerce/v1)

    • Purpose: Main API endpoint for sending tracking data and managing store integration
    • Data sent:
      • Product view events (product ID, name, category, price, timestamp)
      • Cart events (product ID, quantity, action type, timestamp)
      • User agent information (browser, device type, version)
      • Anonymous session identifiers
      • Store configuration data
    • When: Data is sent in real-time when these events occur on your store
    • No personal customer data is transmitted

  2. Error Reporting API (https://integration.valyrion.com/error)

    • Purpose: Collects error information to help improve plugin stability
    • Data sent:
      • Error type and message
      • Plugin version
      • WordPress and WooCommerce versions
      • Anonymous store identifier
    • When: Only sent when an error occurs during plugin operation
    • No personal or sensitive data is included

Service Provider Information

These services are provided by Valyrion ApS:
* Website: https://valyrion.com
* Terms of Service: https://www.valyrion.com/legal/woocommerce-privacy-policy-terms
* Privacy Policy: https://www.valyrion.com/legal/woocommerce-privacy-policy-terms

Data Security

  • All data is transmitted securely using HTTPS
  • API authentication is required using your unique API key
  • No personal customer information is collected or stored
  • All data handling complies with GDPR and POPIA regulations
  • Data is processed and stored in secure Microsoft Azure data centers

Privacy Policy

This plugin collects anonymous shopping behavior data including product views and cart interactions. No personal customer information is collected or stored. All data is transmitted securely to the Happy Ads platform. For more information about how your data is handled, please see our privacy policy at https://happypay.co.za/privacy.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/happy-ads directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the WooCommerce->Happy Ads screen to configure the plugin.
  4. Enter your Happy Ads API key to start tracking.
sections.faq:
What data is tracked?

The plugin tracks:
* Product views (when a customer views a product page)
* Add to cart actions
* Remove from cart actions

How is tracking data sent?

Data is sent securely via API calls to the Happy Ads platform using your unique API key.

Will this affect my site’s performance?

No, the plugin is designed to be lightweight and only tracks specific actions without impacting your site’s performance.

Where can I get help and support?

If you have problems with setup or anything else related to this plugin, you can always contact us at brittney@happypay.co.za

Where can I sign up for Happy Ads?

To sign up for this solution, you must contact us at brittney@happypay.co.za

Where can I submit feedback?

You are always welcome to give feedback and praise, or tell us about a bug you have found. Send feedback, wishes and/or anything else related to this plugin to: brittney@happypay.co.za
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fixed: PHP warning “Undefined array key _wpnonce” on ad click-through landing pages
  • Fixed: utm_source / utm_medium were never recorded, because the nonce they were gated
    behind can never be present on an off-site click-through

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Product view tracking
  • Cart action tracking
  • Error tracking system
